'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|We need you again. Looks like this rat's not crawling out of his hole with that package unless we give him a kick. So you need to get in touch with him ASAP, and my guys are short on equipment. Can you bring it? I'll give you the list.}}

==Objectives==
* Stash 3 [[Electronic components]] at Prapor's new camp on [[Lighthouse]]
* Stash a [[Military cable]] at Prapor's new camp on [[Lighthouse]]
* Stash 3 [[Capacitors]] at Prapor's new camp on [[Lighthouse]]

==Rewards==
* +15,000 [[EXP]]
* 300,000 Roubles
** 315,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 345,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 2× [[6B45 armored rig (Medic, EMR)]]
{{quote|Whatcha think of our camp? Why the hell didn't we set up there sooner, huh... That's what you call a good position.}}
